Subject: Q3 Senior Exec Headcount — signoff and delegation

Team,

Attached is the updated Q3 senior exec headcount plan (q3-exec-hc-plan-v3.xlsx). Short version: we need signoff to move forward with offers to two priority candidates and to open one final search. Timeline is tight — candidates expect offers by EOD Feb 17.

Summary (proposed hires):
- Head of Product (L9) — target hire: internal referral pipeline (1 hire)
  - Proposed comp band: $375k–$450k base, target OTE 20% bonus, RSU grant 0.6–0.9% 4y with 1y cliff
- VP Eng (L8) — backfill/high priority (1 hire)
  - Proposed comp band: $300k–$360k base, 15% bonus, RSU 0.35–0.6%
- Head, Cloud Partnerships (L8) — search to close (1 hire)
  - Proposed comp band: $280k–$340k base, 15% bonus, RSU 0.25–0.5%

Financial impact: see tab "Run Rate" in the attachment — incremental annual comp + equity run-rate ~ $2.1M fully loaded. Finance note: we have cushion in Q3 hiring budget but need explicit reserve for March payroll and signing bonuses.

Requests:
1) Formal signoff on bands and headcount by Tue Feb 16 EOD so Talent can issue offers.
2) Delegate offer authority: propose Laura to sign final offers for Head of Product up to $420k cash comp; Marcus to sign for Partners roles up to $330k. Anything above these caps requires Vivek sign-off.
3) Legal to pre-clear any unusual terms and to use the attached offer-template-mgmt.pdf.

Next steps: if I don’t hear concerns, Talent will send offer letters to the two priority candidates tomorrow morning and request countersignature.

Attachments: q3-exec-hc-plan-v3.xlsx, offer-template-mgmt.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

Aditya — thanks, reviewed. A couple quick clarifications before we finalize: 

- For Head of Product, can you confirm whether the band above includes target RSU refresh budget? We should be explicit about first-year cash vs ongoing OPEX.
- For VP Eng, hiring manager requests a discretionary $25k sign-on for relocation; happy to include if we route through the signing bonus pool. Please confirm if this needs separate approval.
- For Partners, want to make sure we’re aligned on the role level vs quota-bearing expectation — this impacts comp structure. If this is a revenue-facing exec, we should consider a small quota-attached variable comp instead of pure bonus.

Legal ops: please review the attached template and confirm any language we must include for execs (change-of-control, accelerated vesting triggers, standard indemnities).

If no major blockers I can accept delegation to sign within the caps you proposed. Prefer to have a final read and sign by Wed morning to keep the timeline.

Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer

Team — thanks for the clear summary. I approve proceeding with the hiring plan with the following conditions: 

1) Cash comp caps: the delegation stands (Laura up to $420k for Head of Product; Marcus up to $330k for Partners). Anything above requires my explicit sign-off.
2) Equity: keep within ranges proposed; do not exceed the top of band without my sign-off. For high-priority candidates we can authorize +/- 0.05% on a case-by-case basis.
3) Signing bonuses: authorize up to $25k for VP Eng if relocation is required, to be charged to hiring discretionary pool; anything larger routed to Finance.
4) Vesting: approve a 4y schedule with 1y cliff. For executive hires, consider a 12-month accelerated partial vesting for change-of-control per legal recommendation.

Please proceed — Laura, please countersign offers for Product; Marcus, please handle Partners. CC Legal for final language. Finance/HR: reserve the budget listed in the plan immediately so offers are cash-flow neutral to headcount forecasts.

This keeps the process moving and respects candidate timelines. Report back on offer acceptance by EOD Feb 16.

Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
